text: 法国兴业银行利率策略师在一份报告中表示，美国中期选举结束后，美国国债市场的关注焦点正重新转向市场基本面。其中，美国10月非农就业报告将于北京时间21:30公布。策略师表示：“油价下跌以及一项重大风险事件的消除，最初推动股市和债市同步上涨，但财政政策、美国国债发行、债务上限以及AI投资步伐等长期问题依然存在。在这一背景下，我们预计美国国债将继续保持避险资产吸引力。”策略师认为，财政刺激效应减弱、通胀趋于温和，以及风险资产阶段性波动，将在中期内支撑收益率温和下行、收益率曲线趋于平坦的市场环境。
text_en: Societe Generale rate strategists said in a report that after the US midterm elections, the focus of the US Treasury market is shifting back to market fundamentals. Among these, the US October nonfarm payrolls report will be released at 21:30 Beijing time. The strategists said: "Falling oil prices and the removal of a major risk event initially drove stocks and bonds to rise together, but long-term issues such as fiscal policy, US Treasury issuance, the debt ceiling and the pace of AI investment remain. Against this backdrop, we expect US Treasuries to continue to retain their appeal as a safe-haven asset." The strategists believe that weakening fiscal stimulus effects, moderating inflation and periodic volatility in risk assets will support a market environment of modestly lower yields and a flatter yield curve in the medium term.
